title: The Half-Light Weather
author: Sebastian Okafor
blurb: Yara Galloway, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
